title_original: 주택임대차계약증서의 확정일자 부여 및 정보제공에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 3 (Agencies Granting Fixed Dates, etc.)
(1) District courts, their branches, and registry offices (hereinafter referred to as "fixed-date granting agencies") shall handle affairs concerning granting fixed dates on housing lease contracts and providing information thereon pursuant to Article 3-6 of the Act.
(2) Fixed-date granting agencies may process personal information under Article 2, subparagraph 1 of the Personal Information Protection Act to perform the affairs under paragraph (1).
